INSERT INTO MonitorAccountProfitLoss (id, balance,frozenBal,sumDeposit,sumWithDraw,sumAdjustAdd,sumAdjustSub,profitLoss,updateTime) ( select a.id,ifnull(w.balance,0) ,ifnull(w.frozenBal,0), ifnull(sum(case when f.businessType='deposit' then f.balance else 0 end),0) as sumDeposit, ifnull(sum(case when f.businessType='withDraw' then f.balance else 0 end),0)-ifnull(sum(case when f.businessType='withDrawRollBack' then f.balance else 0 end),0) as sumWithDraw, ifnull(sum(case when f.businessType='assetAdjustAdd' then f.balance else 0 end),0) as sumAdjustAdd, ifnull(sum(case when f.businessType='assetAdjustSub' then f.balance else 0 end),0) as sumAdjustSub, ifnull(w.balance,0)+ (ifnull(sum(case when f.businessType='withDraw' or f.businessType='assetAdjustSub' then f.balance else 0 end),0)-ifnull(sum(case when f.businessType='withDrawRollBack' then f.balance else 0 end),0)) -ifnull(sum(case when f.businessType='assetAdjustAdd' or f.businessType='deposit' then f.balance else 0 end),0) as profitLoss, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(NOW())*1000 as updateTime from Account a left join WalletAsset w on a.id = w.accountId left join WalletAssetFlows f on a.id = f.accountId group by a.id ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE balance = VALUES(balance), frozenBal = VALUES(frozenBal), sumDeposit = VALUES(sumDeposit), sumWithDraw = VALUES(sumWithDraw), sumAdjustAdd = VALUES(sumAdjustAdd), sumAdjustSub = VALUES(sumAdjustSub), profitLoss = VALUES(profitLoss), updateTime = VALUES(updateTime)

select 0 as id, ifnull(sum(balance),0) as balance, ifnull(sum(frozenBal),0) as frozenBal, ifnull(sum(sumDeposit),0) as sumDeposit, ifnull(sum(sumWithDraw),0) as sumWithDraw, ifnull(sum(sumAdjustAdd),0) as sumAdjustAdd, ifnull(sum(sumAdjustSub),0) as sumAdjustSub, ifnull(sum(profitLoss),0) as profitLoss, UNIX_TIMESTAMP(NOW())*1000 as updateTime from MonitorAccountProfitLoss
